broadcast.packagerPlacement: explicitly consented owner device or isolated native host
broadcast.originPlacement: gateway-local initially; CDN adapter only after privacy and cost gate

secrets.source: root-readable host files or orchestrator secret mount
secrets.rotation: replace mount atomically, recreate service, revoke old grants and verify readiness

container.capabilities: none except NET_ADMIN on the pinned host-network firewall guard

egress.enforcement: DOCKER-USER source-subnet allowlist maintained by pinned firewall guard
nativePackager: configured TURN over UDP/TCP 3478 or TCP/TLS 5349
egress.dns: Docker embedded DNS; host resolver performs the upstream lookup outside the scoped container subnets
egress.default: drop all other new forwarded traffic from the dedicated production egress subnets
egress.build: package registries are reachable only from isolated build containers

release.strategy: immutable candidate image plus health-gated atomic recreate
